display_name: 独立时频恢复频谱比值约束源域训练
description: 固定原 IQ 损失加 0.1 倍相邻频谱比值损失；只使用合法源域配对 IQ。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 GPU2 FP32 TF32 off deterministic; training batch 32, CPU ground prediction

data.representation: Source paired received/clean IQ; no DURA output in source fit
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 32768 source fit IDs randomly sampled without replacement after excluding RX4/6/8 day3 and the 672 fixed source pilot IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: 672 previously explored source pilot IDs, excluded from direct-model fit; source waveform diagnostic only

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: Fresh 15558434-parameter direct time-frequency network with zero residual output; no prior G or F weights
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source augmentation physical IDs/roles and F-free source caches; no G or F checkpoint loaded during fitting
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No learned restoration or F state during fitting; DURA only for frozen post-training source diagnostic and ground control
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fresh new branch, fixed final epoch20; no target-based selection or adaptation
